diagnosis: The request performance telemetry route resolves CPU and memory utilization statistics using the requestId parameter without checking if metric.userId matches the authenticated req.user.id. Users can infer the computational workload and data volume of requests executed by other platform accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/telemetry/requests/req_batch_import_9901/metrics HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.saas.com:9105
Authorization: Bearer <user_sam_token>
